name: Jagsonpal Services Limited
about: Jagsonpal Services Limited operates as a financial services company in India. The company engages sale and purchase of stocks and equities, and trading in commodities. It also provides leasing and hire purchase services and financial consultancy. The company was formerly known as Jagsonpal Finance & Leasing Ltd. and changed its name to Jagsonpal Services Limited in September 2025. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
